mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS today_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_trade_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = '已支付' AND (logistics_status IS NULL OR logistics_status = '待发货') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_delivery_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = '库存不足' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS exception_order_count FROM order_main WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}

SELECT order_status AS label, COUNT(1) AS count, 0 AS percent, CASE order_status WHEN '已支付' THEN '#5b8def' WHEN '已完成' THEN '#73bf69' WHEN '待支付' THEN '#f1c40f' WHEN '已发货' THEN '#26c6da' WHEN '库存不足' THEN '#f0445e' ELSE '#8d929b' END AS color FROM order_main WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY CASE order_status WHEN '已支付' THEN 1 WHEN '已完成' THEN 2 WHEN '待支付' THEN 3 WHEN '已发货' THEN 4 WHEN '库存不足' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m/%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS trade_amount FROM order_main WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m/%d') ORDER BY MIN(create_time)

SELECT order_id, order_no, user_id, product_name, product_num, total_amount, order_status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, logistics_company, logistics_no, logistics_status, current_location, expect_arrive_time, create_time, pay_time, delivery_time, finish_time FROM order_main WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT order_no AS order_no, product_name AS product_name, product_num AS product_num, total_amount AS total_amount, order_status AS order_status, CASE WHEN order_status = '库存不足' THEN '扣减失败' ELSE 'stock-center' END AS stock_service, CASE WHEN order_status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') THEN 'pay-center' ELSE '-' END AS pay_service, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:%i') AS order_time FROM order_main ORDER BY CASE order_no WHEN 'DD202505190001' THEN 1 WHEN 'DD202505190002' THEN 2 WHEN 'DD202505190003' THEN 3 WHEN 'DD202505190004' THEN 4 WHEN 'DD202505190005' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END, create_time DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT order_no AS order_no, product_name AS product_name, product_num AS product_num, total_amount AS total_amount, order_status AS order_status, CASE WHEN order_status = '库存不足' THEN '扣减失败' ELSE 'stock-center' END AS stock_service, CASE WHEN order_status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成') THEN 'pay-center' ELSE '-' END AS pay_service, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%H:%i') AS order_time FROM order_main WHERE order_status IN ('已支付', '已发货', '已完成', '库存不足') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 8
